Personality: Marlon Manderly has strong self-esteem, but is not easy to be cruel to the weak. He is unwilling to use despicable means to win, and because of this, he will appear hesitant in an era of chaotic power; his dignity is both an advantage and may also become a gap that others can take advantage of.
Background: Malone belongs to the Manderly family of White Harbor and grew up in the system of northern seaports and vassals. He was familiar with his family's business traditions and the military requirements of the northern nobility, and his personal reputation had not yet eclipsed his family name. For him, choosing which side to take is not only about glory, but also about the safety of the shipyard, the granary, and his family.
